messages.content: amar first paid subscriber peyechi, ekhon expectation manage korbo kivabe
Congrats on that milestone, genuinely. Expectation manage korার jonno prothom step hocche clear kore dewa kototuko content ar koto frequency e ashবে.
hae eta thik e korchi, but over-deliver korার pressure feel hocche

That pressure is common early on, but consistently over-delivering sets an unsustainable bar for yourself long term. Set expectations you can comfortably maintain, then occasionally surprise with bonus content - eta better strategy over-promising er cheye.
